title: OpenAI says it signed agreements with independent assessors Apollo Research, METR, Transluce, and Goodfire for its first phase of AI model embedded assessments (OpenAI)
summary: OpenAI: OpenAI says it signed agreements with independent assessors Apollo Research, METR, Transluce, and Goodfire for its first phase of AI model embedded assessments — We have signed agreements with four independent assessors—Apollo Research, METR, Transluce, and Goodfire—for our first phase of embedded assessments.
